knowledge.title: API Development
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev develops secure, scalable, and high-performance APIs using Python, FastAPI, REST architecture, GraphQL, OAuth, JWT authentication, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, and cloud-native deployment.

knowledge.title: REST APIs
knowledge.content: REST APIs are designed using clean resource-based architecture with proper HTTP methods, status codes, validation, pagination, filtering, sorting, versioning, and comprehensive documentation.

knowledge.title: GraphQL APIs
knowledge.content: GraphQL APIs can be implemented for projects that benefit from flexible data querying and reduced over-fetching. REST remains a common default unless GraphQL better fits the use case.

knowledge.title: Authentication
knowledge.content: APIs support JWT authentication, OAuth 2.0, API keys, refresh tokens, role-based access control, secure sessions, and optional multi-factor authentication.

knowledge.title: Webhooks
knowledge.content: Webhook integrations enable real-time communication between systems. Supported use cases include payment events, CRM updates, notifications, order processing, and automation triggers.

knowledge.title: Third-Party Integrations
knowledge.content: APIs can integrate with OpenAI, Stripe, PayPal, Twilio, WhatsApp Business API, Google APIs, Microsoft APIs, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, and many other services.

knowledge.title: API Security
knowledge.content: Security features include HTTPS, rate limiting, request validation, CORS, authentication, authorization, encrypted secrets, audit logging, IP restrictions, and secure environment variable management.

knowledge.title: API Documentation
knowledge.content: FastAPI automatically generates interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation, making APIs easy to understand, test, and integrate.

knowledge.title: Performance
knowledge.content: Performance is improved using asynchronous programming, Redis caching, optimized database queries, pagination, background workers, and scalable deployment strategies.

knowledge.title: AI APIs
knowledge.content: AI APIs can integrate language models, embeddings, RAG pipelines, vector databases, document processing, chatbots, AI agents, and automation workflows.

knowledge.title: Deployment
knowledge.content: APIs can be deployed using Docker on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, VPS servers, or private infrastructure.

knowledge.title: Monitoring
knowledge.content: Production APIs include logging, health checks, monitoring, metrics, alerting, error tracking, request tracing, backups, and performance monitoring.

faqs.question: Do you build APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowthsStack.Dev develops secure REST APIs, GraphQL APIs where appropriate, webhook integrations, authentication systems, and scalable backend services.

faqs.question: Which API framework do you use?
faqs.answer: FastAPI is the primary framework because it provides excellent performance, automatic documentation, async support, and strong validation.

faqs.question: Do you build REST APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. REST APIs are built with authentication, validation, pagination, filtering, versioning, logging, and documentation.

faqs.question: Do you support GraphQL?
faqs.answer: Yes. GraphQL can be implemented when it aligns with the project's architecture and data requirements.

faqs.question: Can you integrate third-party APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate payment gateways, AI services, CRMs, messaging platforms, cloud services, and many other APIs.

faqs.question: Can you create webhooks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Webhooks can trigger automation, synchronize systems, process payments, update CRMs, and send notifications in real time.

faqs.question: Can you secure APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Security includes JWT, OAuth, API keys, HTTPS, rate limiting, validation, logging, and role-based access control.

faqs.question: Can you integrate OpenAI?
faqs.answer: Yes. OpenAI APIs can be integrated into chatbots, AI agents, document processing, automation systems, and SaaS platforms.

faqs.question: Do you provide API documentation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation are provided for easier testing and integration.

faqs.question: Can you deploy APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. APIs can be deployed using Docker on AWS, Azure, GCP, Railway, Render, VPS, or other cloud environments.
